### Must fix
#### 1. Make the duplicate-metadata fixture otherwise valid
[tools/ref/dense-logits.py:588](https://github.com/midagedev/bloomery/blob/efdc55d36f7f65d426e2dab8f992a4f41e21fbb3/tools/ref/dense-logits.py#L588) Removing `or pair[0] in fields` from `read_meta()` leaves this test green: missing `dtype` triggers a different `ValueError`. An in-memory mutation check confirmed this.
Repair the fixture now so a later duplicate-key regression turns the test red. Replace its write with:

```python
        meta.write_text("format\tbloomery-forced-logits-v1\nformat\tbloomery-forced-logits-v1\ndtype\tfloat32-le\nlast_step\ttrue\ncomplete\ttrue\n")
```

Complexity: diagnostics report `run` 164→176 and `run_arm` 35→46; these are aiming signals, not findings.
Silent failure: `read_meta()` rejects malformed or duplicate keys, unsupported formats and incomplete rows; the fixture masks which rejection fired.
Tests: isolated mutation confirms the original fixture masks missing duplicate detection. The replacement exposes that mutant, parses as Python and sits on an added line.
Gates: no CUDA gates run by the validator; the PR disclaims NVIDIA acceptance.
Escape catalog: no C1–C4 pattern applies to these findings.
